chronologie.d-cennies-d-innovation-dans-les-t: Decades of innovation in French and global telecommunications, giving rise to technologies still used in enterprise networks today.
chronologie.de-la-lign-e-alcatel-la-plateforme: From the Alcatel lineage to today's Rainbow platform
chronologie.deux-solutions-une-infrastructure: Two solutions, one sovereign infrastructure hosted in France, deployed by SMEs, large enterprises, and public organizations around the world.

clients.des-collectivit-s-aux-grands: From local authorities to large enterprises, from healthcare institutions to universities : every day, teams rely on Rainbow to stay connected, backed by ALE's ecosystem of more than 3 400 business partners.
clients.des-organisations-de-toute-taille: Organizations of every size, everywhere in the world

engagement.choisir-rainbow-c-est-s-appuyer: Choosing Rainbow means relying on the infrastructure and teams of an established publisher, not an unproven young startup. In concrete terms, that means :
engagement.en-choisissant-rainbow-vous: By choosing Rainbow, you join an ecosystem that ALE has deployed across more than 3 400 business partners worldwide — not just a piece of standalone software.
engagement.l-h-bergement-l-exploitation-et-le: Rainbow's hosting, operations, and support are all handled from France by ALE's teams — see our <0>sovereignty page</0> for full certification details.
engagement.la-r-d-de-rainbow-s-appuie-sur-des: Rainbow's R&D draws on decades of ALE expertise in IP telephony, enterprise networks, and unified communications.
engagement.rainbow-est-dit-par-ale: Rainbow is published by <0>ALE International SAS</0>, a company incorporated under French law and headquartered in Colombes.
engagement.rainbow-n-est-pas-une-startup-isol: Rainbow isn't an isolated startup : it's a product by Alcatel-Lucent

heritage.ans-d-innovation-dans-les: Years of innovation in enterprise communications
heritage.naissance-d-ale-comme-entreprise: ALE founded as an independent company
heritage.rainbow-est-la-plateforme-cloud-de: Rainbow is Alcatel-Lucent's cloud platform for business communication and collaboration, built by a French publisher with more than 100 years of expertise in enterprise communications. Founded in 2014 when it split from Alcatel-Lucent, ALE designed Rainbow as its answer to the new realities of cloud collaboration, all without ever leaving France or abandoning its historic know-how in telephony and enterprise networks.

heritage.si-ge-social-colombes-op-r-sous: Headquartered in Colombes, operating under French law

body.adopter-rainbow-c-est-choisir-une: Adopting Rainbow means choosing a platform that grows with your organization. Whether you’re a 20-person SME or a large group with 50,000 employees, Rainbow adapts to your needs, your industry, and your regulatory constraints.

body.conformite-rgpd-native-avec: Native GDPR compliance with a DPA provided
body.contrairement-aux-plateformes: Unlike American platforms that subject your data to the CLOUD Act, Rainbow guarantees that your communications remain under European jurisdiction. This is a major differentiator for the public sector, healthcare, defense, and financial services.
body.copier-le-lien-de-cet-article_aria-label: Copy the link to this article
body.dans-un-contexte-de-renforcement: Amid tightening regulation (GDPR, NIS2, HDS), data sovereignty is no longer optional. Rainbow is hosted in Europe, on ISO 27001-certified infrastructure, and meets HDS requirements for healthcare institutions.
body.dans-un-monde-ou-le-travail-a: In a world where remote work and hybrid teams have become the norm, businesses face a major challenge: maintaining smooth communication, effective collaboration, and strong engagement, no matter where their people are located. Rainbow, Alcatel-Lucent's unified communication platform, was designed precisely to address these challenges.

body.formations-internes-conferences: Internal training sessions, customer conferences, product launches, general meetings… Rainbow Webinar gives you a professional studio entirely within your browser. No more last-minute technical glitches or complicated tools to set up.
body.interface-rainbow-collaboration: Rainbow Collaboration interface — unified channels, messages, and workspaces.
body.interface-rainbow-collaboration_alt: Rainbow Collaboration interface showing messaging channels, team spaces, and the discussion thread
body.interface-rainbow-webinar-en_alt: Live Rainbow Webinar interface with presentation panel, active poll, and participant list
body.jusqu-a-200-participants-peuvent: Up to 200 participants can join a video conference from any device. Screen sharing, collaborative whiteboards, and breakout rooms turn every meeting into a productive working session.
body.l-integration-avec-vos-outils: Integration with your existing tools (Microsoft 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and more than 50 business connectors) allows Rainbow to fit naturally into your current workflows, without disrupting your teams’ habits.
body.l-interactivite-est-favorisee-avec: Interactivity is boosted with real-time polls, Q&A, and collaborative workspaces.
body.la-meilleure-plateforme-du-monde: The best platform in the world is worthless if your teams don’t adopt it. Rainbow was built with an obsessive focus on user experience : an intuitive interface, native apps across every platform (Windows, Mac, iOS, Android), and an almost non-existent learning curve.
body.la-plateforme-s-articule-autour-de: The platform is built around two complementary offerings: <0>Rainbow Collaboration</0>, for everyday team interactions, and <1>Rainbow Webinar</1>, for large-scale online events. Together, they cover the full spectrum of your organization’s communication needs.
body.la-plupart-des-entreprises: Most companies juggle a dozen different tools: messaging software, a video conferencing solution, a file management tool, a webinar platform… Rainbow brings all of this together under one roof, eliminating the friction of constant context-switching and reducing the cognitive load on your teams.
body.la-salle-de-preparation-backstage: The backstage area lets speakers prepare and rehearse before participants arrive. The moderator controls the flow of the event : opening the floor, managing questions, launching polls, and sharing resources.
body.la-vraie-question-n-est-plus-de: The real question is no longer whether you should unify your communication tools, but when. And the sooner you do it, the sooner you’ll see the gains in productivity, security, and team engagement.
body.le-taux-d-adoption-de-rainbow-est: Rainbow’s adoption rate is 40 % higher than competing platforms thanks to its intuitive onboarding.
body.les-canaux-thematiques-permettent: Topic-based channels let you organize discussions by project, department, or subject. Messages are searchable, shared files are indexed, and every conversation has a history accessible to all members.
body.les-obligations-legales-et-les: The legal obligations and best practices for protecting your employees’ data.
body.les-participants-ne-sont-pas-de: Participants aren’t just spectators. Real-time polls, moderated Q&A, emoji reactions, a dedicated chat : Rainbow Webinar turns every event into an interactive and memorable experience.
body.mais-si-vous-n-avez-jamais-utilise: But if you've never used Rainbow at work, it can be hard to know where to start... Don't worry, it's less complicated than it looks !

faq.ai-and-machine-learning-use-the: AI and machine learning use the information gathered to support informed decisions and trigger alerts or recommendations before an event occurs.
faq.ale-s-stated-ambition-is-to: ALE's stated ambition is to connect people, machines, and processes while helping create a more sustainable future, a principle reflected in the design of its cloud solutions like Rainbow.
faq.all-data-processed-through-rainbow: All data processed through Rainbow is hosted exclusively in France, on infrastructure operated under French and European law. This means your data is fully subject to GDPR, entirely outside the scope of the US Cloud Act, and never accessible to foreign government authorities without going through European legal channels. Unlike Microsoft Teams or Google Workspace, whose data centers in Europe remain operated by US-headquartered parent companies, Rainbow's infrastructure has no jurisdictional ambiguity. Your data is where you think it is, governed by the law you expect.
faq.can-rainbow-integrate-with-our: Can Rainbow integrate with our existing tools like CRM, ERP and industry software?
faq.can-rainbow-interface-with: Can Rainbow interface with Microsoft Teams?
faq.can-we-embed-rainbow-communication: Can we embed Rainbow communication features directly into our own products or client-facing applications?
faq.do-managers-have-tools-to: Do managers have tools to supervise communications?
faq.do-we-need-to-replace-our-current: Do we need to replace our current system to use Rainbow?
faq.does-ale-build-rainbow-with: Does ALE build Rainbow with sustainability in mind?
faq.does-rainbow-comply-with: Does Rainbow comply with international data protection regulation?
faq.does-rainbow-offer-custom-pricing: Does Rainbow offer custom pricing for large organizations or multi-year contracts?
faq.does-rainbow-use-my-company-s-data: Does Rainbow use my company's data to train its AI model?
faq.does-rainbow-work-for-field: Does Rainbow work for field workers and mobile teams, not just office-based employees?
faq.each-secure-messaging-group-bubble: Each secure messaging group (bubble) can include up to 300 internal and external participants, with a time-stamped history accessible at all times.
faq.for-most-organisations-rainbow-is: For most organisations, Rainbow is operational within a single working day. There is no server infrastructure to configure, no lengthy IT project to manage, and no training programme required before teams can begin using it productively. Because Rainbow's AI features activate within existing conversations rather than requiring new behaviours, adoption happens organically from day one. For larger organisations with specific integration requirements, embedding Rainbow into existing applications via API, for instance, deployment timelines vary based on the complexity of the integration, and Rainbow's technical team provides dedicated support throughout the process.
faq.how-does-rainbow-s-ai-help: How does Rainbow's AI help anticipate business needs?
faq.how-long-does-it-take-to-deploy: How long does it take to deploy Rainbow across the organization?
faq.how-many-participants-can-join-a: How many participants can join a Rainbow video conference?
faq.how-many-people-can-join-a-single: How many people can join a single messaging group?
faq.is-rainbow-compliant-with-gdpr-and: Is Rainbow compliant with GDPR and French data protection regulation?
faq.is-rainbow-suitable-for-small: Is Rainbow suitable for small business with fewer than 10 employees?
faq.it-brings-presence-status: It brings presence status synchronization, a single phone number, single sign-on, and three-way calling, with no additional deployment or training required.
faq.meetings-can-host-up-to-120: Meetings can host up to 120 participants, with up to 12 simultaneous video streams.
faq.no-rainbow-connects-to-your: No, Rainbow connects to your existing telephony infrastructure, whether on-premise or in the Cloud, and enhances what you already have rather than replacing it, by connecting an existing on-premise telephony system or a cloud PBX to Rainbow.
faq.no-your-conversations-meeting: No. Your conversations, meeting summaries, documents, and communications are never used to train Rainbow's AI models or any external model. This is a structural guarantee, not a contractual opt-out. The AI processes your data to generate outputs for you, summaries, transcriptions, translations, and that data stays within your environment. This is one of the most significant differences between Rainbow AI and US-based AI tools like Microsoft Copilot or Google Gemini, where data usage policies are more ambiguous and subject to change.
faq.rainbow-ai-is-launching-in: Rainbow AI is launching in September 2025 with a suite of native AI capabilities designed for professional environments. These include automatic meeting summaries delivered immediately after every call, real-time translation across all video conversations, voice-to-structured-text transcription for field and mobile workers, AI-assisted professional writing within the messaging interface, intelligent message prioritization for high-volume communication environments, and automated follow-up tracking from meeting commitments. All AI features are active from the first conversation, require no configuration, and are available to every user regardless of company size, from a solo practitioner to a 10 000 person organisation.
faq.rainbow-can-be-deployed-on: Rainbow can be deployed on-premises, in a hybrid model, or in a private or public cloud, depending on the organization's constraints.
faq.rainbow-includes-a-local: Rainbow includes a local survivability solution that maintains minimal phone service in the event of a cloud connection loss.
faq.rainbow-is-accessible-on-desktop: Rainbow is accessible on desktop, web, smartphone, and tablet, with continuity of service across devices.
faq.rainbow-is-iso-27001-certified-and: Rainbow is ISO 27001 certified and holds European certifications such as CAN in Italy, C5 in Germany, ENS in Spain, and CSPN from France's ANSSI.
faq.rainbow-s-business-partner-program: Rainbow's business partner program is designed for technology integrators, resellers, consulting firms, and independent software vendors who want to embed or resell Rainbow capabilities as part of their own offer. Partners gain access to Rainbow's full API and SDK documentation, dedicated technical support for integration projects, co-marketing resources, and a revenue-sharing model structured around the value generated through the partnership. The program has no minimum volume commitment at entry level, making it accessible to boutique integrators and regional resellers as well as national technology distributors.
faq.real-time-supervision-tools: Real-time supervision tools, detailed call history, and performance indicators are made available to management teams.
faq.the-platform-is-designed-with-a: The platform is designed with a data privacy focus, following applicable law such as GDPR and CCPA.
faq.the-telephony-module-covers-call: The telephony module covers call reception quality, opening hours management, an interactive voice server, call groups, dashboards and statistics, third-party application integration, and an operator console. Additional capabilities such as customizable call routing and real-time supervision further enrich this offering.
faq.the-us-cloud-act-passed-in-2018: The US Cloud Act, passed in 2018, grants American federal authorities the legal power to compel US-headquartered technology companies to produce data stored anywhere in the world, including on European servers. If your organisation uses Teams, Zoom, Slack, or Google Workspace, your data is technically accessible to US authorities under this framework, without you being notified. For companies handling sensitive client data, patient records, legal documents, or strategic business information, this is an active compliance risk, not a theoretical one. Rainbow operates entirely outside this framework. There is no US parent company, no Cloud Act exposure, and no scenario in which your data can be accessed by a foreign government without your knowledge.
faq.there-are-several-tiers-rainbow: There are several tiers: Rainbow Essential, a free service to try out the solution, followed by Business, Enterprise and Enterprise Conference plans, each adding collaboration services, video conferencing, or unlimited conference calling minutes.

faq.yes-a-connector-rainbow-telephony: Yes. A connector, Rainbow Telephony for Microsoft Teams, allows an existing on-premises or cloud PABX to be connected to Teams, without changing team workflows.
faq.yes-and-this-is-a-deliberate: Yes, and this is a deliberate design choice. Many enterprise communication tools, Teams in particular, are optimised for office-based, desk-bound workers with reliable internet connections and full-specification computers. Rainbow's mobile application is built for field environments: lightweight, low-bandwidth, and fully functional on standard smartphones. Voice transcription, message prioritisation, and AI-generated structured reports are specifically designed for workers who communicate verbally on site and need documentation to happen automatically, without typing, without desk access, and without switching between multiple applications.
faq.yes-and-this-is-one-of-rainbow-s: Yes, and this is one of Rainbow's most significant technical differentiators. Through its open API and SDK architecture, Rainbow integrates directly into the tools your teams already use, rather than requiring your organisation to restructure around it. This means a financial advisor can launch a video call from within their banking application. A doctor can trigger a teleconsultation from a patient record. A logistics coordinator can receive automatically structured incident reports from field workers' voice messages, all within existing workflows, without switching applications. If your organisation has specific integration requirements, Rainbow's business partner programme includes dedicated technical support for custom integrations.
faq.yes-and-unlike-most-enterprise: Yes, and unlike most enterprise communication tools, Rainbow does not impose minimum seat counts, complex onboarding requirements, or pricing structures that only make sense at scale. A five-person legal practice, a three-practitioner medical cabinet, or a solo consultant with a small client-facing team accesses the same AI capabilities, the same data sovereignty guarantees, and the same integration possibilities as a multinational corporation. The only difference is the number of users paying. There is no feature dilution, no SMB-tier product with reduced capabilities, and no hidden upgrade path required to access the full Rainbow experience.
faq.yes-natively-and-by-design-rainbow: Yes, natively and by design. Rainbow was built around European data protection requirements from the ground up, not retrofitted to comply with them after the fact. This includes full GDPR compliance, compatibility with CNIL guidelines, and architecture that supports HDS certification requirements for healthcare organisations. For organisations in regulated sectors, healthcare, legal, financial services, public sector, Rainbow's compliance posture is not an additional feature to configure. It is the default state of the product.
faq.yes-rainbow-s-sdk-allows: Yes. Rainbow's SDK allows organisations to embed communication capabilities, video calls, messaging, AI features, directly into their own applications, creating branded experiences that keep clients within the organisation's own digital environment. This is particularly relevant for financial institutions that want to offer adviser video calls within their banking app, healthcare providers embedding teleconsultation within patient portals, and any organisation that wants to provide branded communication without directing clients to a third-party tool. This level of native embedding is not available in Teams or Zoom without significant custom development investment.
faq.yes-webinar-services-are-available: Yes, webinar services are available for audiences of 120, 500 and soon, 1 000 participants, under dedicated subscriptions.
faq.yes-while-rainbow-s-standard: Yes. While Rainbow's standard pricing is transparent and available directly on the marketplace, organisations with specific volume requirements, multi-entity structures, or multi-year commitment preferences can access tailored commercial arrangements through Rainbow's enterprise sales team. Given the diversity of grand compte requirements, including specific SLA commitments, dedicated infrastructure options, and custom integration support, we recommend contacting our commercial team directly for an initial conversation rather than attempting to fit complex requirements into a standard pricing grid.
faq.your-data-belongs-to-you-entirely: Your data belongs to you, entirely and without condition. Upon termination of your Rainbow subscription, you retain full access to export all your data, conversations, files, AI-generated summaries, and any other content generated within the platform, in standard, portable formats. Rainbow does not retain your data after the termination period defined in your contract, and no data is archived for Rainbow's own purposes. This is a direct reflection of the sovereignty principle that governs the entire product: your data was never Rainbow's to keep.

certifications.la-certification-hds-h-bergement: The HDS certification (Hébergement de Données de Santé, or Health Data Hosting) is a mandatory French certification that guarantees a provider hosting health data meets strict requirements for security, confidentiality, and the protection of medical data.
certifications.la-ferpa-family-educational-rights: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act) is a US law that protects the confidentiality of students' school records and gives them the right to access, correct, and control the disclosure of their educational information.
certifications.la-loi-sur-la-portabilit-et-la: The Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) is a US certification that guarantees the security of healthcare-related data.
certifications.la-norme-bsi-c5-publi-e-par-l: The BSI C5 standard, published by Germany's Federal Office for Information Security (BSI), establishes a baseline security standard for cloud services and helps customers assess, manage, and oversee their cloud service providers.
certifications.les-centres-de-donn-es-s-appuient: The data centers rely on modern technologies certified to ISO-27001 and SOC standards. They are enclosed by barbed-wire fencing, and physical access is strictly monitored 24×7.
certifications.les-services-rainbow-sont-con-us: Rainbow services are designed to comply with the European directive on data protection, which strengthens the protection of privacy and personal data.
certifications.rainbow-a-obtenu-la-certification: Rainbow™ has obtained the First Level Security Certification (CSPN), issued by ANSSI, France's highest security standard. Only three communications solutions have obtained it, and Rainbow is the largest of the three.
certifications.rainbow-est-h-berg-en-france-op-r: Rainbow is hosted in France, operated under French law, certified by ANSSI, and HDS-compliant for health data. No Cloud Act. No access possible by foreign authorities. It's the only guarantee that matters when your communications are confidential.
certifications.une-certification-d-livr-e-par-le: A certification issued under the Spanish national security framework, aimed at protecting information systems against internal and external cyber threats and incidents.
certifications.une-certification-nationale-de: A national cybersecurity certification issued by Italy's National Cybersecurity Agency (ACN) to certify that ICT products and services comply with the security requirements set out in Italian law.
certifications.vos-donn-es-prot-g-es-h-berg-es-en: Your data, protected & hosted in France

risques.alcatel-lucent-est-une-soci-t-de: Alcatel-Lucent is a company incorporated under French law, headquartered in Colombes. Its product strategy and data governance remain steered from France, independently of the group's shareholder structure.
risques.collectivit-s-h-pitaux: Local authorities, hospitals, educational institutions, and companies in regulated sectors are subject to heightened confidentiality obligations, often incompatible with a solution subject to a foreign jurisdiction.
risques.la-conformit-de-rainbow-ne-repose: Rainbow's compliance does not rest on a contractual clause but on its very architecture: a French publisher, French hosting, French operations. The Cloud Act structurally cannot apply.
risques.le-cloud-act-2018-et-le-patriot: The Cloud Act (2018) and the Patriot Act apply to any company incorporated under US law, regardless of where the data is physically hosted. The location of the datacenter alone is therefore not enough to guarantee legal insulation.
risques.le-cloud-act-permet-aux-autorit-s: The Cloud Act allows US authorities to access data hosted by a US company, even when that data is stored outside the United States. For a local authority, a healthcare institution, or a regulated business, this means that messaging or video conferencing software published by a US provider remains, in theory, accessible to a foreign authority.
risques.le-secteur-public-et-la-sant-en: The public sector and healthcare on the front line
risques.pourquoi-la-souverainet-num-rique: Why digital sovereignty is no longer negotiable
risques.rainbow-une-r-ponse-structurelle: Rainbow: a structural response, not a contractual one

securite.acc-s-physique-strictement-contr-l: Strictly controlled physical access 24/7, infrastructure certified to ISO 27001 and SOC standards, and reinforced network isolation.
securite.chiffrement-des-flux-en-transit: Encryption of data in transit (WebRTC, TLS) and at rest (AES-256), across all Rainbow usage: messages, calls, video, and files.
securite.la-conformit-r-glementaire-ne: Regulatory compliance alone is not enough without a robust technical architecture. Here is what actually protects your communications day to day.
securite.s-curit-technique-le-d-tail-qui: Technical security, the detail that reassures
securite.scans-de-vuln-rabilit-s-r-seau: Network vulnerability scans, application penetration tests, and manual security audits carried out on an ongoing basis by independent third parties.
